WITH scored AS (
WITH alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
		SELECT
			mia.content_id,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title = $3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE $3 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contiguous_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $3 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE mia.normalized_title = $3
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	)

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $3 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $3 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $3 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $3 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $3 || ' ' || mi.year::text) OR COALESCE(search_alias.exact_title_match, 0) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $3 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $3 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $3 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $3 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $4::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $4::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $3 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $5 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($5)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi LEFT JOIN alias_scores search_alias ON search_alias.content_id = mi.content_id
		WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (title_mi.title_normalized = $3 OR (title_mi.title_normalized LIKE $3 || ' %' AND (title_mi.year > 0 AND title_mi.title_normalized = $3 || ' ' || title_mi.year::text))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
UNION ALL

		SELECT DISTINCT 
			ece.episode_id AS content_id,
			'episode'::text AS type,
			ece.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $3 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_normalized = $3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $3 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE $3 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $4::int IS NOT NULL AND (ece.year) = $4::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $3 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(ece.search_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $5 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($5)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id
		WHERE ece.search_title_normalized = $3 AND si.type = 'series'
), page AS (
		SELECT scored.*, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_count
		FROM scored WHERE $1::text IS NOT NULL
		ORDER BY exact_title_match DESC, contiguous_title_match DESC, year_match DESC,
	phrase_rank DESC, title_prefix_rank DESC, overview_rank DESC,
	LOWER(title) ASC, content_id ASC

WITH scored AS (
WITH alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
		SELECT
			mia.content_id,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title = $4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE $4 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contiguous_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE mia.normalized_title = $4
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	)

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $4 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $4 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $4 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $4 || ' ' || mi.year::text) OR COALESCE(search_alias.exact_title_match, 0) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $5::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $5::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($6)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi LEFT JOIN alias_scores search_alias ON search_alias.content_id = mi.content_id
		WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (title_mi.title_normalized = $4 OR (title_mi.title_normalized LIKE $4 || ' %' AND (title_mi.year > 0 AND title_mi.title_normalized = $4 || ' ' || title_mi.year::text))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND mi.type = ANY($3) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
), page AS (
		SELECT scored.*, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_count
		FROM scored WHERE $1::text IS NOT NULL
		ORDER BY exact_title_match DESC, contiguous_title_match DESC, year_match DESC,
	phrase_rank DESC, title_prefix_rank DESC, overview_rank DESC,
	LOWER(title) ASC, content_id ASC

			MIN(CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE mia.normalized_title = $4

WITH scored AS (
WITH alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
		SELECT
			mia.content_id,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title = $4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE $4 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contiguous_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE mia.normalized_title = $4
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	)

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $4 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $4 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $4 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $4 || ' ' || mi.year::text) OR COALESCE(search_alias.exact_title_match, 0) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $5::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $5::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($6)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi LEFT JOIN alias_scores search_alias ON search_alias.content_id = mi.content_id
		WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (title_mi.title_normalized = $4 OR (title_mi.title_normalized LIKE $4 || ' %' AND (title_mi.year > 0 AND title_mi.title_normalized = $4 || ' ' || title_mi.year::text))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND mi.type = ANY($3) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
UNION ALL

		SELECT DISTINCT 
			ece.episode_id AS content_id,
			'episode'::text AS type,
			ece.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_normalized = $4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $5::int IS NOT NULL AND (ece.year) = $5::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(ece.search_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($6)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id
		WHERE ece.search_title_normalized = $4 AND si.type = 'series'
), page AS (
		SELECT scored.*, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_count
		FROM scored WHERE $1::text IS NOT NULL
		ORDER BY exact_title_match DESC, contiguous_title_match DESC, year_match DESC,
	phrase_rank DESC, title_prefix_rank DESC, overview_rank DESC,
	LOWER(title) ASC, content_id ASC

			MIN(CASE WHEN $3 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words

			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $3 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE mia.normalized_title = $3
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	)

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,

			CASE WHEN $4::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $4::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,

			MIN(CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words

			mia.content_id,

			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE mia.normalized_title = $4
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	)

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,

			CASE WHEN $5::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $5::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,

			MIN(CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE mia.normalized_title = $4

			MIN(CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia

WITH alias_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
			SELECT

				) AS fuzzy_rank,
				MAX(similarity(public.normalize_search_text($1), mia.normalized_title)) AS fuzzy_full_rank
			FROM media_item_aliases mia
			WHERE $2 <<% mia.normalized_title
			GROUP BY mia.content_id

			SELECT
				mi.content_id,

			FROM media_items mi
			WHERE $2 <<% mi.title_normalized
			UNION ALL
			SELECT content_id, fuzzy_rank, fuzzy_full_rank
			FROM alias_candidates

			SELECT content_id, MAX(fuzzy_rank) AS fuzzy_rank, MAX(fuzzy_full_rank) AS fuzzy_full_rank
			FROM candidates
			GROUP BY content_id

			MIN(CASE WHEN $3 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia

			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE mia.normalized_title LIKE $5 || '%'
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	)

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,

			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $6::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $6::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,

					0.65 * similarity($2, mia.normalized_title)

WITH alias_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
			SELECT
				mia.content_id,
				MAX(
					0.65 * similarity($2, mia.normalized_title)
						+ 0.35 * strict_word_similarity($2, mia.normalized_title)
				) AS fuzzy_rank,
				MAX(similarity(public.normalize_search_text($1), mia.normalized_title)) AS fuzzy_full_rank
			FROM media_item_aliases mia
			WHERE $2 <<% mia.normalized_title
			GROUP BY mia.content_id
		), candidates AS (
			SELECT
				mi.content_id,
				0.65 * similarity($2, mi.title_normalized)
					+ 0.35 * strict_word_similarity($2, mi.title_normalized) AS fuzzy_rank,
				similarity(public.normalize_search_text($1), mi.title_normalized) AS fuzzy_full_rank
			FROM media_items mi
			WHERE $2 <<% mi.title_normalized
			UNION ALL
			SELECT content_id, fuzzy_rank, fuzzy_full_rank
			FROM alias_candidates
		), candidate_scores AS (
			SELECT content_id, MAX(fuzzy_rank) AS fuzzy_rank, MAX(fuzzy_full_rank) AS fuzzy_full_rank
			FROM candidates
			GROUP BY content_id

			SELECT

WITH scored AS (
WITH alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
		SELECT
			mia.content_id,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title = $4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE $4 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contiguous_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE mia.normalized_title LIKE $5 || '%'
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	)

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $4 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $4 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $4 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $4 || ' ' || mi.year::text) OR COALESCE(search_alias.exact_title_match, 0) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $6::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $6::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($7)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi LEFT JOIN alias_scores search_alias ON search_alias.content_id = mi.content_id
		WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE title_mi.title_normalized LIKE $5 || '%' UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND mi.type = ANY($3) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
UNION ALL

		SELECT DISTINCT 
			ece.episode_id AS content_id,
			'episode'::text AS type,
			ece.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_normalized = $4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $6::int IS NOT NULL AND (ece.year) = $6::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(ece.search_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($7)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id
		WHERE ece.search_title_normalized LIKE $5 || '%' AND si.type = 'series'
), page AS (
		SELECT scored.*, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_count
		FROM scored WHERE $1::text IS NOT NULL
		ORDER BY exact_title_match DESC, contiguous_title_match DESC, year_match DESC,
	phrase_rank DESC, title_prefix_rank DESC, overview_rank DESC,
	LOWER(title) ASC, content_id ASC

WITH scored AS (

		SELECT
			mia.content_id,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title = $4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE $4 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contiguous_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE mia.normalized_title LIKE $5 || '%'
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	)

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $4 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $4 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $4 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $4 || ' ' || mi.year::text) OR COALESCE(search_alias.exact_title_match, 0) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $6::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $6::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,

WITH scored AS (
WITH alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
		SELECT
			mia.content_id,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title = $4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE $4 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contiguous_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE mia.normalized_title LIKE $5 || '%'
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	)

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $4 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $4 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $4 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $4 || ' ' || mi.year::text) OR COALESCE(search_alias.exact_title_match, 0) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $6::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $6::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($7)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi LEFT JOIN alias_scores search_alias ON search_alias.content_id = mi.content_id
		WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE title_mi.title_normalized LIKE $5 || '%' UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND mi.type = ANY($3) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
), page AS (
		SELECT scored.*, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_count
		FROM scored WHERE $1::text IS NOT NULL
		ORDER BY exact_title_match DESC, contiguous_title_match DESC, year_match DESC,
	phrase_rank DESC, title_prefix_rank DESC, overview_rank DESC,
	LOWER(title) ASC, content_id ASC

			CASE WHEN $4::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $4::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,

		COALESCE(e.metadata_s3_path, '') AS metadata_s3_path,
		COALESCE(e.metadata_etag, '') AS metadata_etag,
		NULL::integer AS season_count,
		COALESCE(si.studios, '{}'::text[]) AS studios,
		COALESCE(si.networks, '{}'::text[]) AS networks,

		COALESCE(si.keywords, '{}'::text[]) AS keywords,

		CASE WHEN e.air_date IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE e.air_date::text END AS release_date,

		COALESCE(si.locked_fields, '{}'::integer[]) AS locked_fields,
		COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(si.status), ''), 'matched') AS status,
		e.created_at,
		e.updated_at
	FROM episodes e
	JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = e.series_id
	LEFT JOIN seasons s ON s.content_id = e.season_id
	WHERE (EXISTS (
		SELECT 1
		FROM episode_libraries el
		WHERE el.episode_id = e.content_id
	))
	  AND si.type = 'series'
) mi

WITH scored AS (
WITH alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
		SELECT
			mia.content_id,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title = $3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE $3 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contiguous_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $3 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	),
title_scored AS MATERIALIZED (

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $3 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $3 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $3 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $3 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $3 || ' ' || mi.year::text) OR COALESCE(search_alias.exact_title_match, 0) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $3 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $3 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $3 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $3 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $4::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $4::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $3 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $5 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($5)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi LEFT JOIN alias_scores search_alias ON search_alias.content_id = mi.content_id
		WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (title_mi.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
UNION ALL

		SELECT DISTINCT 
			ece.episode_id AS content_id,
			'episode'::text AS type,
			ece.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $3 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_normalized = $3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $3 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE $3 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $4::int IS NOT NULL AND (ece.year) = $4::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $3 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(ece.search_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $5 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($5)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) AND si.type = 'series'
)

			(CASE WHEN $5 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($5)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank

WITH scored AS (
WITH alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
		SELECT
			mia.content_id,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title = $4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE $4 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contiguous_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	),
title_scored AS MATERIALIZED (

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $4 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $4 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $4 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $4 || ' ' || mi.year::text) OR COALESCE(search_alias.exact_title_match, 0) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $5::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $5::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($6)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi LEFT JOIN alias_scores search_alias ON search_alias.content_id = mi.content_id
		WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (title_mi.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND mi.type = ANY($3) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
)
SELECT * FROM title_scored
		UNION ALL
		SELECT *
		FROM (
			
		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $4 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $4 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $4 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $4 || ' ' || mi.year::text)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $5::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $5::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)))::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($6)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi
		WHERE (mi.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND mi.type = ANY($3) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
		) overview_scored
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM title_scored)
		  AND overview_scored.overview_rank >= 0.15
), page AS (
		SELECT scored.*, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_count
		FROM scored
		ORDER BY exact_title_match DESC, contiguous_title_match DESC, year_match DESC,
	phrase_rank DESC, title_prefix_rank DESC, overview_rank DESC,
	LOWER(title) ASC, content_id ASC

		FROM media_item_aliases mia

WITH alias_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (

				MAX(
					0.65 * similarity($2, mia.normalized_title)

				) AS fuzzy_rank,
				MAX(similarity(public.normalize_search_text($1), mia.normalized_title)) AS fuzzy_full_rank
			FROM media_item_aliases mia
			WHERE $2 <<% mia.normalized_title
			GROUP BY mia.content_id
		), candidates AS (
			SELECT
				mi.content_id,
				0.65 * similarity($2, mi.title_normalized)

				similarity(public.normalize_search_text($1), mi.title_normalized) AS fuzzy_full_rank
			FROM media_items mi
			WHERE $2 <<% mi.title_normalized
			UNION ALL
			SELECT content_id, fuzzy_rank, fuzzy_full_rank
			FROM alias_candidates

			SELECT content_id, MAX(fuzzy_rank) AS fuzzy_rank, MAX(fuzzy_full_rank) AS fuzzy_full_rank
			FROM candidates
			GROUP BY content_id

		FROM media_item_aliases mia

			CASE WHEN $5::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $5::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,

WITH scored AS (
WITH alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
		SELECT
			mia.content_id,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title = $4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE $4 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contiguous_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	),
title_scored AS MATERIALIZED (

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $4 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $4 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $4 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $4 || ' ' || mi.year::text) OR COALESCE(search_alias.exact_title_match, 0) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $5::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $5::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($6)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi LEFT JOIN alias_scores search_alias ON search_alias.content_id = mi.content_id
		WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (title_mi.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND mi.type = ANY($3) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
UNION ALL

		SELECT DISTINCT 
			ece.episode_id AS content_id,
			'episode'::text AS type,
			ece.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_normalized = $4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,

		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) AND si.type = 'series'
)

WITH alias_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
			SELECT

				MAX(
					0.65 * similarity($2, mia.normalized_title)

				) AS fuzzy_rank,
				MAX(similarity(public.normalize_search_text($1), mia.normalized_title)) AS fuzzy_full_rank
			FROM media_item_aliases mia
			WHERE $2 <<% mia.normalized_title
			GROUP BY mia.content_id
		), candidates AS (
			SELECT
				mi.content_id,
				0.65 * similarity($2, mi.title_normalized)
					+ 0.35 * strict_word_similarity($2, mi.title_normalized) AS fuzzy_rank,
				similarity(public.normalize_search_text($1), mi.title_normalized) AS fuzzy_full_rank
			FROM media_items mi
			WHERE $2 <<% mi.title_normalized
			UNION ALL
			SELECT content_id, fuzzy_rank, fuzzy_full_rank
			FROM alias_candidates
		), candidate_scores AS (
			SELECT content_id, MAX(fuzzy_rank) AS fuzzy_rank, MAX(fuzzy_full_rank) AS fuzzy_full_rank
			FROM candidates
			GROUP BY content_id

WITH scored AS (
WITH alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
		SELECT
			mia.content_id,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title = $4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE $4 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contiguous_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	),
title_scored AS MATERIALIZED (

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $4 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $4 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $4 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $4 || ' ' || mi.year::text) OR COALESCE(search_alias.exact_title_match, 0) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $5::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $5::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($6)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi LEFT JOIN alias_scores search_alias ON search_alias.content_id = mi.content_id
		WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (title_mi.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND mi.type = ANY($3) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
UNION ALL

		SELECT DISTINCT 
			ece.episode_id AS content_id,
			'episode'::text AS type,
			ece.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_normalized = $4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $5::int IS NOT NULL AND (ece.year) = $5::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(ece.search_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($6)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) AND si.type = 'series'
)
SELECT * FROM title_scored
		UNION ALL
		SELECT *
		FROM (
			
		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $4 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $4 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $4 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $4 || ' ' || mi.year::text)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $5::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $5::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)))::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($6)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi
		WHERE (mi.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND mi.type = ANY($3) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
UNION ALL

		SELECT DISTINCT 
			ece.episode_id AS content_id,
			'episode'::text AS type,
			ece.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_normalized = $4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $5::int IS NOT NULL AND (ece.year) = $5::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(ece.search_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(ts_rank_cd(ece.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)))::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($6)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id
		WHERE (ece.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND si.type = 'series'
		) overview_scored
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM title_scored)
		  AND overview_scored.overview_rank >= 0.15
), page AS (
		SELECT scored.*, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_count
		FROM scored
		ORDER BY exact_title_match DESC, contiguous_title_match DESC, year_match DESC,
	phrase_rank DESC, title_prefix_rank DESC, overview_rank DESC,
	LOWER(title) ASC, content_id ASC

		FROM media_item_aliases mia

			CASE WHEN $5::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $5::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,

WITH scored AS (
WITH alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
		SELECT
			mia.content_id,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title = $4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE $4 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contiguous_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	),
title_scored AS MATERIALIZED (

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,

		FROM media_item_aliases mia

			CASE WHEN $4::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $4::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $3 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,

		FROM media_item_aliases mia

			CASE WHEN $5::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $5::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,

		FROM media_item_aliases mia

			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $5::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $5::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,

		COALESCE(e.metadata_etag, '') AS metadata_etag,

		e.created_at,
		e.updated_at

	JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = e.series_id
	LEFT JOIN seasons s ON s.content_id = e.season_id
	WHERE (EXISTS (
		SELECT 1
		FROM episode_libraries el

) mi

WITH scored AS (
WITH alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
		SELECT
			mia.content_id,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title = $4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE $4 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contiguous_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	),
title_scored AS MATERIALIZED (

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $4 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $4 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $4 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $4 || ' ' || mi.year::text) OR COALESCE(search_alias.exact_title_match, 0) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $5::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $5::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($6)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi LEFT JOIN alias_scores search_alias ON search_alias.content_id = mi.content_id
		WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (title_mi.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND mi.type = ANY($3) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
UNION ALL

		SELECT DISTINCT 
			ece.episode_id AS content_id,
			'episode'::text AS type,
			ece.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_normalized = $4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $5::int IS NOT NULL AND (ece.year) = $5::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(ece.search_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($6)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) AND si.type = 'series'
)
SELECT * FROM title_scored

			(ts_rank_cd(ece.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)))::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($6)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank

			SELECT DISTINCT mia.content_id FROM media_item_aliases mia
			WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))),
title_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT mi.content_id FROM media_items mi WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (title_mi.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND mi.type = ANY($3) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id) UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT ece.episode_id AS content_id FROM episode_catalog_entries ece JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) AND si.type = 'series'),
candidates AS (
		SELECT content_id FROM title_candidates
		UNION ALL
		SELECT content_id FROM (SELECT mi.content_id FROM media_items mi WHERE (mi.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND mi.type = ANY($3) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id) AND ts_rank_cd(mi.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)) >= 0.15 UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT ece.episode_id AS content_id FROM episode_catalog_entries ece JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id WHERE (ece.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND si.type = 'series' AND ts_rank_cd(ece.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)) >= 0.15) overview_candidates
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM title_candidates)
	) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM candidates

WITH scored AS (
WITH alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
		SELECT
			mia.content_id,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title = $4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE $4 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contiguous_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	),
title_scored AS MATERIALIZED (

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $4 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $4 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $4 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $4 || ' ' || mi.year::text) OR COALESCE(search_alias.exact_title_match, 0) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $5::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $5::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($6)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi LEFT JOIN alias_scores search_alias ON search_alias.content_id = mi.content_id
		WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (title_mi.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND mi.type = ANY($3) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
)
SELECT * FROM title_scored
		UNION ALL
		SELECT *
		FROM (
			
		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $4 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $4 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $4 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $4 || ' ' || mi.year::text)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $4 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $5::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $5::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $4 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)))::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($6)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi
		WHERE (mi.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND mi.type = ANY($3) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
		) overview_scored
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM title_scored)
		  AND overview_scored.overview_rank >= 0.15
), page AS (
		SELECT scored.*, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_count
		FROM scored
		ORDER BY exact_title_match DESC, contiguous_title_match DESC, year_match DESC,

		COALESCE(e.metadata_s3_path, '') AS metadata_s3_path,
		COALESCE(e.metadata_etag, '') AS metadata_etag,

		COALESCE(si.studios, '{}'::text[]) AS studios,
		COALESCE(si.networks, '{}'::text[]) AS networks,

		CASE WHEN e.air_date IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE e.air_date::text END AS release_date,

		COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(si.status), ''), 'matched') AS status,
		e.created_at,
		e.updated_at
	FROM episodes e
	JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = e.series_id
	LEFT JOIN seasons s ON s.content_id = e.season_id
	WHERE (EXISTS (
		SELECT 1
		FROM episode_libraries el
		WHERE el.episode_id = e.content_id

) mi

WITH scored AS (
WITH alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
		SELECT
			mia.content_id,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title = $3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE $3 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contiguous_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $3 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	),
title_scored AS MATERIALIZED (

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $3 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $3 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $3 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $3 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $3 || ' ' || mi.year::text) OR COALESCE(search_alias.exact_title_match, 0) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $3 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $3 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $3 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $3 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $4::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $4::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $3 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $5 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($5)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi LEFT JOIN alias_scores search_alias ON search_alias.content_id = mi.content_id
		WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (title_mi.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
UNION ALL

		SELECT DISTINCT 
			ece.episode_id AS content_id,
			'episode'::text AS type,
			ece.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $3 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_normalized = $3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $3 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE $3 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $4::int IS NOT NULL AND (ece.year) = $4::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $3 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(ece.search_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $5 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($5)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) AND si.type = 'series'
)
SELECT * FROM title_scored

WITH scored AS (
WITH alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
		SELECT
			mia.content_id,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title = $3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE $3 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contiguous_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $3 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	),
title_scored AS MATERIALIZED (

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $3 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $3 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $3 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $3 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $3 || ' ' || mi.year::text) OR COALESCE(search_alias.exact_title_match, 0) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $3 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $3 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $3 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $3 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $4::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $4::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $3 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $5 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($5)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi LEFT JOIN alias_scores search_alias ON search_alias.content_id = mi.content_id
		WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (title_mi.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
UNION ALL

		SELECT DISTINCT 
			ece.episode_id AS content_id,
			'episode'::text AS type,
			ece.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $3 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_normalized = $3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,

			CASE WHEN $4::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $4::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $3 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $3 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,

		FROM media_item_aliases mia

		FROM media_item_aliases mia

candidates AS (
		SELECT content_id FROM title_candidates
		UNION ALL
		SELECT content_id FROM (SELECT mi.content_id FROM media_items mi WHERE (mi.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND mi.type = ANY($3) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id) AND ts_rank_cd(mi.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)) >= 0.15 UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT ece.episode_id AS content_id FROM episode_catalog_entries ece JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id WHERE (ece.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND si.type = 'series' AND ts_rank_cd(ece.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)) >= 0.15) overview_candidates
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM title_candidates)

		FROM media_item_aliases mia
