WITH scored AS (
WITH alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
		SELECT
			mia.content_id,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title = $6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE $6 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contiguous_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	),
title_scored AS MATERIALIZED (

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $6 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $6 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $6 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $6 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $6 || ' ' || mi.year::text) OR COALESCE(search_alias.exact_title_match, 0) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $6 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $6 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $6 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $7::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $7::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($8)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi LEFT JOIN alias_scores search_alias ON search_alias.content_id = mi.content_id
		WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (title_mi.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = mi.content_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($3)) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
UNION ALL

		SELECT DISTINCT 
			ece.episode_id AS content_id,
			'episode'::text AS type,
			ece.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $6 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_normalized = $6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE $6 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $7::int IS NOT NULL AND (ece.year) = $7::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(ece.search_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($8)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM (
		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,
		       ece.search_title_normalized, ece.search_title_vector, ece.content_rating_age, ece.advisory_age, si.content_id AS search_series_parent_id
		FROM (
		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,
		       ece.search_title_normalized, ece.search_title_vector, ece.content_rating_age, ece.advisory_age
		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) AND ece.media_folder_id = ANY($4) OFFSET 0
		) ece LEFT JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id AND si.type = 'series'
		OFFSET 0
	) ece
		WHERE ece.search_series_parent_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = ece.series_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($5))
)
SELECT * FROM title_scored
		UNION ALL
		SELECT *
		FROM (
			
		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $6 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $6 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $6 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $6 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $6 || ' ' || mi.year::text)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $6 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $6 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $6 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $7::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $7::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)))::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($8)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi
		WHERE (mi.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = mi.content_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($3)) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
UNION ALL

		SELECT DISTINCT 
			ece.episode_id AS content_id,
			'episode'::text AS type,
			ece.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $6 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_normalized = $6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE $6 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $7::int IS NOT NULL AND (ece.year) = $7::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(ece.search_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(ts_rank_cd(ece.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)))::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($8)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM (
		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,
		       ece.search_title_normalized, ece.search_title_vector, ece.search_overview_vector, ece.content_rating_age, ece.advisory_age, si.content_id AS search_series_parent_id
		FROM (
		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,
		       ece.search_title_normalized, ece.search_title_vector, ece.search_overview_vector, ece.content_rating_age, ece.advisory_age
		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece WHERE (ece.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND ece.media_folder_id = ANY($4) OFFSET 0
		) ece LEFT JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id AND si.type = 'series'
		OFFSET 0
	) ece
		WHERE ece.search_series_parent_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = ece.series_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($5))
		) overview_scored
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM title_scored)
		  AND overview_scored.overview_rank >= 0.15
), page AS (
		SELECT scored.*
		FROM scored
		ORDER BY exact_title_match DESC, contiguous_title_match DESC, year_match DESC,
	phrase_rank DESC, title_prefix_rank DESC, overview_rank DESC,
	LOWER(title) ASC, content_id ASC

			MIN(CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	),

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,

WITH scored AS (
WITH alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
		SELECT
			mia.content_id,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title = $7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE $7 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contiguous_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	),
title_scored AS MATERIALIZED (

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $7 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $7 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $7 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $7 || ' ' || mi.year::text) OR COALESCE(search_alias.exact_title_match, 0) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $8::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $8::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $9 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($9)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi LEFT JOIN alias_scores search_alias ON search_alias.content_id = mi.content_id
		WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (title_mi.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND mi.type = ANY($3) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = mi.content_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($4)) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
UNION ALL

		SELECT DISTINCT 
			ece.episode_id AS content_id,
			'episode'::text AS type,
			ece.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_normalized = $7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $8::int IS NOT NULL AND (ece.year) = $8::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(ece.search_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,

		FROM (
		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,

		COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(si.status), ''), 'matched') AS status,
		e.created_at,
		e.updated_at
	FROM episodes e
	JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = e.series_id
	LEFT JOIN seasons s ON s.content_id = e.season_id
	WHERE (EXISTS (
		SELECT 1
		FROM episode_libraries el

) mi
		WHERE page.type = 'episode'

WITH search_parameters AS (SELECT $1::text, $2::text, $7::text, $8::int, $9::text),
alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
			SELECT DISTINCT mia.content_id FROM media_item_aliases mia
			WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))),
title_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT mi.content_id FROM media_items mi WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (title_mi.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND mi.type = ANY($3) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = mi.content_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($4)) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id) UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT ece.episode_id AS content_id FROM (
		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,
		       ece.search_title_normalized, ece.search_title_vector, ece.content_rating_age, ece.advisory_age, si.content_id AS search_series_parent_id
		FROM (
		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,
		       ece.search_title_normalized, ece.search_title_vector, ece.content_rating_age, ece.advisory_age
		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) AND ece.media_folder_id = ANY($5) OFFSET 0
		) ece LEFT JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id AND si.type = 'series'
		OFFSET 0
	) ece WHERE ece.search_series_parent_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = ece.series_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($6))),
candidates AS (
		SELECT content_id FROM title_candidates
		UNION ALL
		SELECT content_id FROM (SELECT mi.content_id FROM media_items mi WHERE (mi.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND mi.type = ANY($3) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = mi.content_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($4)) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id) AND ts_rank_cd(mi.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)) >= 0.15 UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT ece.episode_id AS content_id FROM (
		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,
		       ece.search_title_normalized, ece.search_title_vector, ece.search_overview_vector, ece.content_rating_age, ece.advisory_age, si.content_id AS search_series_parent_id
		FROM (
		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,
		       ece.search_title_normalized, ece.search_title_vector, ece.search_overview_vector, ece.content_rating_age, ece.advisory_age
		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece WHERE (ece.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND ece.media_folder_id = ANY($5) OFFSET 0
		) ece LEFT JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id AND si.type = 'series'
		OFFSET 0
	) ece WHERE ece.search_series_parent_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = ece.series_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($6)) AND ts_rank_cd(ece.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)) >= 0.15) overview_candidates
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM title_candidates)
	) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM candidates

WITH scored AS (
WITH alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
		SELECT
			mia.content_id,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title = $7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE $7 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contiguous_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	),
title_scored AS MATERIALIZED (

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $7 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $7 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $7 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $7 || ' ' || mi.year::text) OR COALESCE(search_alias.exact_title_match, 0) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $8::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $8::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $9 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($9)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi LEFT JOIN alias_scores search_alias ON search_alias.content_id = mi.content_id
		WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (title_mi.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND mi.type = ANY($3) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = mi.content_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($4)) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
UNION ALL

		SELECT DISTINCT 
			ece.episode_id AS content_id,
			'episode'::text AS type,
			ece.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_normalized = $7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $8::int IS NOT NULL AND (ece.year) = $8::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(ece.search_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $9 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($9)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM (
		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,
		       ece.search_title_normalized, ece.search_title_vector, ece.content_rating_age, ece.advisory_age, si.content_id AS search_series_parent_id
		FROM (
		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,
		       ece.search_title_normalized, ece.search_title_vector, ece.content_rating_age, ece.advisory_age
		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) AND ece.media_folder_id = ANY($5) OFFSET 0
		) ece LEFT JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id AND si.type = 'series'
		OFFSET 0
	) ece
		WHERE ece.search_series_parent_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = ece.series_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($6))
)
SELECT * FROM title_scored
		UNION ALL
		SELECT *
		FROM (
			
		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $7 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $7 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $7 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $7 || ' ' || mi.year::text)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $8::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $8::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)))::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $9 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($9)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi
		WHERE (mi.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND mi.type = ANY($3) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = mi.content_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($4)) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
UNION ALL

		SELECT DISTINCT 
			ece.episode_id AS content_id,
			'episode'::text AS type,
			ece.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_normalized = $7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $8::int IS NOT NULL AND (ece.year) = $8::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(ece.search_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(ts_rank_cd(ece.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)))::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $9 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($9)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM (
		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,
		       ece.search_title_normalized, ece.search_title_vector, ece.search_overview_vector, ece.content_rating_age, ece.advisory_age, si.content_id AS search_series_parent_id
		FROM (
		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,
		       ece.search_title_normalized, ece.search_title_vector, ece.search_overview_vector, ece.content_rating_age, ece.advisory_age
		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece WHERE (ece.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND ece.media_folder_id = ANY($5) OFFSET 0
		) ece LEFT JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id AND si.type = 'series'
		OFFSET 0
	) ece
		WHERE ece.search_series_parent_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = ece.series_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($6))
		) overview_scored
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM title_scored)
		  AND overview_scored.overview_rank >= 0.15
), page AS (
		SELECT scored.*, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_count
		FROM scored
		ORDER BY exact_title_match DESC, contiguous_title_match DESC, year_match DESC,
	phrase_rank DESC, title_prefix_rank DESC, overview_rank DESC,
	LOWER(title) ASC, content_id ASC

WITH scored AS (
WITH alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
		SELECT
			mia.content_id,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title = $6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE $6 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contiguous_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	),
title_scored AS MATERIALIZED (

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $6 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $6 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $6 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $6 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $6 || ' ' || mi.year::text) OR COALESCE(search_alias.exact_title_match, 0) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $6 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $6 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $6 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $7::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $7::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($8)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi LEFT JOIN alias_scores search_alias ON search_alias.content_id = mi.content_id
		WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (title_mi.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = mi.content_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($3)) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
UNION ALL

		SELECT DISTINCT 
			ece.episode_id AS content_id,
			'episode'::text AS type,
			ece.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $6 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_normalized = $6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE $6 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $7::int IS NOT NULL AND (ece.year) = $7::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,

		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,

		FROM media_item_aliases mia

		COALESCE(si.locked_fields, '{}'::integer[]) AS locked_fields,
		COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(si.status), ''), 'matched') AS status,
		e.created_at,
		e.updated_at
	FROM episodes e
	JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = e.series_id
	LEFT JOIN seasons s ON s.content_id = e.season_id
	WHERE (EXISTS (
		SELECT 1
		FROM episode_libraries el
		WHERE el.episode_id = e.content_id
	))
	  AND si.type = 'series'
) mi

WITH search_parameters AS (SELECT $1::text, $2::text, $6::text, $7::int, $8::text),
alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
			SELECT DISTINCT mia.content_id FROM media_item_aliases mia
			WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))),
title_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT mi.content_id FROM media_items mi WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (title_mi.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = mi.content_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($3)) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id) UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT ece.episode_id AS content_id FROM (
		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,
		       ece.search_title_normalized, ece.search_title_vector, ece.content_rating_age, ece.advisory_age, si.content_id AS search_series_parent_id
		FROM (
		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,
		       ece.search_title_normalized, ece.search_title_vector, ece.content_rating_age, ece.advisory_age
		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) AND ece.media_folder_id = ANY($4) OFFSET 0
		) ece LEFT JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id AND si.type = 'series'
		OFFSET 0
	) ece WHERE ece.search_series_parent_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = ece.series_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($5))),
candidates AS (
		SELECT content_id FROM title_candidates
		UNION ALL
		SELECT content_id FROM (SELECT mi.content_id FROM media_items mi WHERE (mi.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = mi.content_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($3)) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id) AND ts_rank_cd(mi.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)) >= 0.15 UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT ece.episode_id AS content_id FROM (
		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,
		       ece.search_title_normalized, ece.search_title_vector, ece.search_overview_vector, ece.content_rating_age, ece.advisory_age, si.content_id AS search_series_parent_id
		FROM (
		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,
		       ece.search_title_normalized, ece.search_title_vector, ece.search_overview_vector, ece.content_rating_age, ece.advisory_age
		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece WHERE (ece.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND ece.media_folder_id = ANY($4) OFFSET 0
		) ece LEFT JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id AND si.type = 'series'
		OFFSET 0
	) ece WHERE ece.search_series_parent_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = ece.series_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($5)) AND ts_rank_cd(ece.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)) >= 0.15) overview_candidates
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM title_candidates)
	) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM candidates

WITH scored AS (
WITH alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
		SELECT
			mia.content_id,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title = $6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE $6 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contiguous_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	),
title_scored AS MATERIALIZED (

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $6 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $6 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $6 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $6 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $6 || ' ' || mi.year::text) OR COALESCE(search_alias.exact_title_match, 0) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $6 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $6 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $6 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $7::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $7::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($8)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi LEFT JOIN alias_scores search_alias ON search_alias.content_id = mi.content_id
		WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (title_mi.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = mi.content_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($3)) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
UNION ALL

		SELECT DISTINCT 
			ece.episode_id AS content_id,
			'episode'::text AS type,
			ece.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $6 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_normalized = $6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE $6 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $7::int IS NOT NULL AND (ece.year) = $7::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(ece.search_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($8)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM (
		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,
		       ece.search_title_normalized, ece.search_title_vector, ece.content_rating_age, ece.advisory_age, si.content_id AS search_series_parent_id
		FROM (
		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,
		       ece.search_title_normalized, ece.search_title_vector, ece.content_rating_age, ece.advisory_age
		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) AND ece.media_folder_id = ANY($4) OFFSET 0
		) ece LEFT JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id AND si.type = 'series'
		OFFSET 0
	) ece
		WHERE ece.search_series_parent_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = ece.series_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($5))
)
SELECT * FROM title_scored
		UNION ALL
		SELECT *
		FROM (
			
		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $6 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $6 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $6 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $6 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $6 || ' ' || mi.year::text)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $6 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $6 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $6 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $7::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $7::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)))::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($8)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi
		WHERE (mi.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = mi.content_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($3)) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
UNION ALL

		SELECT DISTINCT 
			ece.episode_id AS content_id,
			'episode'::text AS type,
			ece.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $6 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_normalized = $6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE $6 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $7::int IS NOT NULL AND (ece.year) = $7::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(ece.search_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(ts_rank_cd(ece.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)))::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($8)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM (
		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,
		       ece.search_title_normalized, ece.search_title_vector, ece.search_overview_vector, ece.content_rating_age, ece.advisory_age, si.content_id AS search_series_parent_id
		FROM (
		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,
		       ece.search_title_normalized, ece.search_title_vector, ece.search_overview_vector, ece.content_rating_age, ece.advisory_age
		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece WHERE (ece.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND ece.media_folder_id = ANY($4) OFFSET 0
		) ece LEFT JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id AND si.type = 'series'
		OFFSET 0
	) ece
		WHERE ece.search_series_parent_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = ece.series_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($5))
		) overview_scored
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM title_scored)
		  AND overview_scored.overview_rank >= 0.15
), page AS (
		SELECT scored.*, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_count
		FROM scored
		ORDER BY exact_title_match DESC, contiguous_title_match DESC, year_match DESC,
	phrase_rank DESC, title_prefix_rank DESC, overview_rank DESC,
	LOWER(title) ASC, content_id ASC

WITH scored AS (
WITH alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
		SELECT
			mia.content_id,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title = $7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE $7 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contiguous_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	),
title_scored AS MATERIALIZED (

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $7 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $7 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $7 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $7 || ' ' || mi.year::text) OR COALESCE(search_alias.exact_title_match, 0) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $8::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $8::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $9 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($9)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi LEFT JOIN alias_scores search_alias ON search_alias.content_id = mi.content_id
		WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (title_mi.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND mi.type = ANY($3) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = mi.content_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($4)) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
UNION ALL

		SELECT DISTINCT 
			ece.episode_id AS content_id,
			'episode'::text AS type,
			ece.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_normalized = $7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $8::int IS NOT NULL AND (ece.year) = $8::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(ece.search_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $9 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($9)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM (
		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,
		       ece.search_title_normalized, ece.search_title_vector, ece.content_rating_age, ece.advisory_age, si.content_id AS search_series_parent_id

	) ece
		WHERE ece.search_series_parent_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = ece.series_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($6))
)

		COALESCE(si.locked_fields, '{}'::integer[]) AS locked_fields,
		COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(si.status), ''), 'matched') AS status,
		e.created_at,
		e.updated_at
	FROM episodes e
	JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = e.series_id
	LEFT JOIN seasons s ON s.content_id = e.season_id
	WHERE (EXISTS (
		SELECT 1
		FROM episode_libraries el

WITH search_parameters AS (SELECT $1::text, $2::text, $7::text, $8::int, $9::text),
alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
			SELECT DISTINCT mia.content_id FROM media_item_aliases mia
			WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))),
title_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT mi.content_id FROM media_items mi WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (title_mi.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND mi.type = ANY($3) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = mi.content_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($4)) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id) UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT ece.episode_id AS content_id FROM (
		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,
		       ece.search_title_normalized, ece.search_title_vector, ece.content_rating_age, ece.advisory_age, si.content_id AS search_series_parent_id
		FROM (
		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,
		       ece.search_title_normalized, ece.search_title_vector, ece.content_rating_age, ece.advisory_age
		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) AND ece.media_folder_id = ANY($5) OFFSET 0
		) ece LEFT JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id AND si.type = 'series'
		OFFSET 0
	) ece WHERE ece.search_series_parent_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = ece.series_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($6))),
candidates AS (
		SELECT content_id FROM title_candidates
		UNION ALL
		SELECT content_id FROM (SELECT mi.content_id FROM media_items mi WHERE (mi.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND mi.type = ANY($3) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = mi.content_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($4)) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id) AND ts_rank_cd(mi.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)) >= 0.15 UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT ece.episode_id AS content_id FROM (
		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,
		       ece.search_title_normalized, ece.search_title_vector, ece.search_overview_vector, ece.content_rating_age, ece.advisory_age, si.content_id AS search_series_parent_id
		FROM (
		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,
		       ece.search_title_normalized, ece.search_title_vector, ece.search_overview_vector, ece.content_rating_age, ece.advisory_age
		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece WHERE (ece.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND ece.media_folder_id = ANY($5) OFFSET 0
		) ece LEFT JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id AND si.type = 'series'
		OFFSET 0
	) ece WHERE ece.search_series_parent_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = ece.series_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($6)) AND ts_rank_cd(ece.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)) >= 0.15) overview_candidates
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM title_candidates)
	) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM candidates

WITH scored AS (
WITH alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
		SELECT
			mia.content_id,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title = $7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE $7 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contiguous_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	),
title_scored AS MATERIALIZED (

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $7 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $7 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $7 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $7 || ' ' || mi.year::text) OR COALESCE(search_alias.exact_title_match, 0) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $8::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $8::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $9 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($9)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi LEFT JOIN alias_scores search_alias ON search_alias.content_id = mi.content_id
		WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (title_mi.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND mi.type = ANY($3) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = mi.content_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($4)) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
UNION ALL

		SELECT DISTINCT 
			ece.episode_id AS content_id,
			'episode'::text AS type,
			ece.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_normalized = $7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $8::int IS NOT NULL AND (ece.year) = $8::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(ece.search_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $9 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($9)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM (
		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,
		       ece.search_title_normalized, ece.search_title_vector, ece.content_rating_age, ece.advisory_age, si.content_id AS search_series_parent_id
		FROM (
		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,
		       ece.search_title_normalized, ece.search_title_vector, ece.content_rating_age, ece.advisory_age
		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) AND ece.media_folder_id = ANY($5) OFFSET 0
		) ece LEFT JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id AND si.type = 'series'
		OFFSET 0
	) ece
		WHERE ece.search_series_parent_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = ece.series_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($6))
)
SELECT * FROM title_scored
		UNION ALL
		SELECT *
		FROM (
			
		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $7 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $7 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $7 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $7 || ' ' || mi.year::text)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $8::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $8::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)))::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $9 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($9)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi
		WHERE (mi.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND mi.type = ANY($3) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = mi.content_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($4)) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
UNION ALL

		SELECT DISTINCT 
			ece.episode_id AS content_id,
			'episode'::text AS type,
			ece.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_normalized = $7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $8::int IS NOT NULL AND (ece.year) = $8::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(ece.search_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(ts_rank_cd(ece.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)))::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $9 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($9)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM (
		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,
		       ece.search_title_normalized, ece.search_title_vector, ece.search_overview_vector, ece.content_rating_age, ece.advisory_age, si.content_id AS search_series_parent_id
		FROM (
		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,
		       ece.search_title_normalized, ece.search_title_vector, ece.search_overview_vector, ece.content_rating_age, ece.advisory_age
		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece WHERE (ece.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND ece.media_folder_id = ANY($5) OFFSET 0
		) ece LEFT JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id AND si.type = 'series'
		OFFSET 0
	) ece
		WHERE ece.search_series_parent_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = ece.series_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($6))
		) overview_scored
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM title_scored)
		  AND overview_scored.overview_rank >= 0.15
), page AS (
		SELECT scored.*, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_count
		FROM scored
		ORDER BY exact_title_match DESC, contiguous_title_match DESC, year_match DESC,
	phrase_rank DESC, title_prefix_rank DESC, overview_rank DESC,
	LOWER(title) ASC, content_id ASC

			mia.content_id,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title = $6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE $6 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contiguous_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	),
title_scored AS MATERIALIZED (

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $6 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $6 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $6 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $6 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $6 || ' ' || mi.year::text) OR COALESCE(search_alias.exact_title_match, 0) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $6 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $6 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $6 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $7::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $7::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($8)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi LEFT JOIN alias_scores search_alias ON search_alias.content_id = mi.content_id
		WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (title_mi.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = mi.content_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($3)) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
UNION ALL

		SELECT DISTINCT 
			ece.episode_id AS content_id,
			'episode'::text AS type,
			ece.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $6 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_normalized = $6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE $6 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $7::int IS NOT NULL AND (ece.year) = $7::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,

			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($8)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM (
		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,
		       ece.search_title_normalized, ece.search_title_vector, ece.content_rating_age, ece.advisory_age, si.content_id AS search_series_parent_id
		FROM (
		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,

		) ece LEFT JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id AND si.type = 'series'
		OFFSET 0
	) ece
		WHERE ece.search_series_parent_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = ece.series_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($5))

			mia.content_id,

			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	),
title_scored AS MATERIALIZED (

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $7 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $7 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $7 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $7 || ' ' || mi.year::text) OR COALESCE(search_alias.exact_title_match, 0) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,

			CASE WHEN $8::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $8::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,

		e.created_at,

	FROM episodes e
	JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = e.series_id

WITH search_parameters AS (SELECT $1::text, $2::text, $7::text, $8::int, $9::text),
alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
			SELECT DISTINCT mia.content_id FROM media_item_aliases mia
			WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))),
title_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT mi.content_id FROM media_items mi WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (title_mi.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND mi.type = ANY($3) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = mi.content_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($4)) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id) UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT ece.episode_id AS content_id FROM (
		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,
		       ece.search_title_normalized, ece.search_title_vector, ece.content_rating_age, ece.advisory_age, si.content_id AS search_series_parent_id
		FROM (
		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,
		       ece.search_title_normalized, ece.search_title_vector, ece.content_rating_age, ece.advisory_age
		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) AND ece.media_folder_id = ANY($5) OFFSET 0
		) ece LEFT JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id AND si.type = 'series'
		OFFSET 0
	) ece WHERE ece.search_series_parent_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = ece.series_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($6))),
candidates AS (
		SELECT content_id FROM title_candidates
		UNION ALL
		SELECT content_id FROM (SELECT mi.content_id FROM media_items mi WHERE (mi.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND mi.type = ANY($3) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = mi.content_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($4)) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id) AND ts_rank_cd(mi.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)) >= 0.15 UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT ece.episode_id AS content_id FROM (
		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,
		       ece.search_title_normalized, ece.search_title_vector, ece.search_overview_vector, ece.content_rating_age, ece.advisory_age, si.content_id AS search_series_parent_id
		FROM (
		SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.series_id, ece.media_folder_id, ece.title, ece.year,
		       ece.search_title_normalized, ece.search_title_vector, ece.search_overview_vector, ece.content_rating_age, ece.advisory_age
		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece WHERE (ece.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND ece.media_folder_id = ANY($5) OFFSET 0
		) ece LEFT JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id AND si.type = 'series'
		OFFSET 0
	) ece WHERE ece.search_series_parent_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = ece.series_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($6)) AND ts_rank_cd(ece.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)) >= 0.15) overview_candidates
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM title_candidates)
	) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM candidates
