WITH scored AS (
WITH alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
		SELECT
			mia.content_id,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title = $8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE $8 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contiguous_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	),
title_scored AS MATERIALIZED (

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $8 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $8 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $8 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $8 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $8 || ' ' || mi.year::text) OR COALESCE(search_alias.exact_title_match, 0) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $8 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $8 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $8 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $9::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $9::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $10 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($10)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi LEFT JOIN alias_scores search_alias ON search_alias.content_id = mi.content_id
		WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (title_mi.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND mi.type = ANY($3) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND (mi.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.content_rating_age <= $4) AND (mi.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.advisory_age <= $5) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
UNION ALL

		SELECT DISTINCT 
			ece.episode_id AS content_id,
			'episode'::text AS type,
			ece.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $8 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_normalized = $8) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE $8 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $9::int IS NOT NULL AND (ece.year) = $9::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(ece.search_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $10 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($10)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) AND si.type = 'series' AND (ece.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.content_rating_age <= $6) AND (ece.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.advisory_age <= $7)
)
SELECT * FROM title_scored
		UNION ALL
		SELECT *
		FROM (
			
		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $8 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $8 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $8 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $8 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $8 || ' ' || mi.year::text)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $8 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $8 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $8 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $9::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $9::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)))::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $10 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($10)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi
		WHERE (mi.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND mi.type = ANY($3) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND (mi.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.content_rating_age <= $4) AND (mi.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.advisory_age <= $5) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
UNION ALL

		SELECT DISTINCT 
			ece.episode_id AS content_id,
			'episode'::text AS type,
			ece.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $8 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_normalized = $8) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE $8 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $9::int IS NOT NULL AND (ece.year) = $9::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(ece.search_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(ts_rank_cd(ece.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)))::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $10 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($10)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id
		WHERE (ece.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND si.type = 'series' AND (ece.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.content_rating_age <= $6) AND (ece.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.advisory_age <= $7)
		) overview_scored
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM title_scored)
		  AND overview_scored.overview_rank >= 0.15
), page AS (
		SELECT scored.*, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_count
		FROM scored
		ORDER BY exact_title_match DESC, contiguous_title_match DESC, year_match DESC,
	phrase_rank DESC, title_prefix_rank DESC, overview_rank DESC,
	LOWER(title) ASC, content_id ASC

WITH search_parameters AS (SELECT $1::text, $2::text, $8::text, $9::int, $10::text),

			WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))),
title_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT mi.content_id FROM media_items mi WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (title_mi.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND mi.type = ANY($3) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND (mi.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.content_rating_age <= $4) AND (mi.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.advisory_age <= $5) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id) UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT ece.episode_id AS content_id FROM episode_catalog_entries ece JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) AND si.type = 'series' AND (ece.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.content_rating_age <= $6) AND (ece.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.advisory_age <= $7)),
candidates AS (
		SELECT content_id FROM title_candidates
		UNION ALL
		SELECT content_id FROM (SELECT mi.content_id FROM media_items mi WHERE (mi.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND mi.type = ANY($3) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND (mi.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.content_rating_age <= $4) AND (mi.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.advisory_age <= $5) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id) AND ts_rank_cd(mi.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)) >= 0.15 UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT ece.episode_id AS content_id FROM episode_catalog_entries ece JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id WHERE (ece.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND si.type = 'series' AND (ece.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.content_rating_age <= $6) AND (ece.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.advisory_age <= $7) AND ts_rank_cd(ece.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)) >= 0.15) overview_candidates
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM title_candidates)
	) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM candidates

WITH scored AS (
WITH alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
		SELECT
			mia.content_id,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title = $8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE $8 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contiguous_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	),
title_scored AS MATERIALIZED (

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $8 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $8 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $8 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $8 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $8 || ' ' || mi.year::text) OR COALESCE(search_alias.exact_title_match, 0) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $8 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $8 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $8 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $9::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $9::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $10 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($10)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi LEFT JOIN alias_scores search_alias ON search_alias.content_id = mi.content_id
		WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (title_mi.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND mi.type = ANY($3) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND (mi.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.content_rating_age <= $4) AND (mi.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.advisory_age <= $5) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
UNION ALL

		SELECT DISTINCT 
			ece.episode_id AS content_id,
			'episode'::text AS type,
			ece.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $8 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_normalized = $8) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE $8 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $9::int IS NOT NULL AND (ece.year) = $9::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(ece.search_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $10 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($10)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) AND si.type = 'series' AND (ece.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.content_rating_age <= $6) AND (ece.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.advisory_age <= $7)
)
SELECT * FROM title_scored
		UNION ALL
		SELECT *
		FROM (
			
		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $8 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $8 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $8 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $8 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $8 || ' ' || mi.year::text)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $8 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $8 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $8 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $9::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $9::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)))::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $10 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($10)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi
		WHERE (mi.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND mi.type = ANY($3) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND (mi.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.content_rating_age <= $4) AND (mi.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.advisory_age <= $5) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
UNION ALL

		SELECT DISTINCT 
			ece.episode_id AS content_id,
			'episode'::text AS type,
			ece.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $8 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_normalized = $8) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE $8 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $9::int IS NOT NULL AND (ece.year) = $9::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(ece.search_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(ts_rank_cd(ece.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)))::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $10 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($10)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id
		WHERE (ece.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND si.type = 'series' AND (ece.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.content_rating_age <= $6) AND (ece.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.advisory_age <= $7)
		) overview_scored
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM title_scored)
		  AND overview_scored.overview_rank >= 0.15
), page AS (
		SELECT scored.*
		FROM scored
		ORDER BY exact_title_match DESC, contiguous_title_match DESC, year_match DESC,
	phrase_rank DESC, title_prefix_rank DESC, overview_rank DESC,
	LOWER(title) ASC, content_id ASC

		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))
		GROUP BY mia.content_id

title_scored AS MATERIALIZED (

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,

			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $8::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $8::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,

WITH scored AS (
WITH alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
		SELECT
			mia.content_id,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title = $7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE $7 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contiguous_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	),
title_scored AS MATERIALIZED (

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $7 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $7 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $7 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $7 || ' ' || mi.year::text) OR COALESCE(search_alias.exact_title_match, 0) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $8::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $8::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $9 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($9)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi LEFT JOIN alias_scores search_alias ON search_alias.content_id = mi.content_id
		WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (title_mi.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND (mi.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.content_rating_age <= $3) AND (mi.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.advisory_age <= $4) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
UNION ALL

		SELECT DISTINCT 
			ece.episode_id AS content_id,
			'episode'::text AS type,
			ece.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_normalized = $7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $8::int IS NOT NULL AND (ece.year) = $8::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(ece.search_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $9 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($9)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) AND si.type = 'series' AND (ece.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.content_rating_age <= $5) AND (ece.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.advisory_age <= $6)
)

WITH scored AS (
WITH alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
		SELECT
			mia.content_id,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title = $7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE $7 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contiguous_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	),
title_scored AS MATERIALIZED (

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $7 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $7 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $7 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $7 || ' ' || mi.year::text) OR COALESCE(search_alias.exact_title_match, 0) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $8::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $8::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $9 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($9)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi LEFT JOIN alias_scores search_alias ON search_alias.content_id = mi.content_id
		WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (title_mi.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND (mi.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.content_rating_age <= $3) AND (mi.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.advisory_age <= $4) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
UNION ALL

		SELECT DISTINCT 
			ece.episode_id AS content_id,
			'episode'::text AS type,
			ece.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_normalized = $7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $8::int IS NOT NULL AND (ece.year) = $8::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(ece.search_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $9 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($9)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) AND si.type = 'series' AND (ece.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.content_rating_age <= $5) AND (ece.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.advisory_age <= $6)
)

		SELECT
			mia.content_id,

			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE $8 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contiguous_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	),
title_scored AS MATERIALIZED (

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $8 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $8 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $8 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $8 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $8 || ' ' || mi.year::text) OR COALESCE(search_alias.exact_title_match, 0) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $8 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $8 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $8 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $9::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $9::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $10 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($10)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank

			mia.content_id,

			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	),
title_scored AS MATERIALIZED (

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $7 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $7 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $7 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $7 || ' ' || mi.year::text) OR COALESCE(search_alias.exact_title_match, 0) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $8::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $8::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,

WITH search_parameters AS (SELECT $1::text, $2::text, $7::text, $8::int, $9::text),
alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
			SELECT DISTINCT mia.content_id FROM media_item_aliases mia
			WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))),
title_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT mi.content_id FROM media_items mi WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (title_mi.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND (mi.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.content_rating_age <= $3) AND (mi.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.advisory_age <= $4) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id) UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT ece.episode_id AS content_id FROM episode_catalog_entries ece JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) AND si.type = 'series' AND (ece.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.content_rating_age <= $5) AND (ece.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.advisory_age <= $6)),
candidates AS (
		SELECT content_id FROM title_candidates
		UNION ALL
		SELECT content_id FROM (SELECT mi.content_id FROM media_items mi WHERE (mi.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND (mi.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.content_rating_age <= $3) AND (mi.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.advisory_age <= $4) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id) AND ts_rank_cd(mi.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)) >= 0.15 UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT ece.episode_id AS content_id FROM episode_catalog_entries ece JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id WHERE (ece.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND si.type = 'series' AND (ece.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.content_rating_age <= $5) AND (ece.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.advisory_age <= $6) AND ts_rank_cd(ece.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)) >= 0.15) overview_candidates
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM title_candidates)
	) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM candidates

WITH scored AS (
WITH alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
		SELECT
			mia.content_id,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title = $7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE $7 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contiguous_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	),
title_scored AS MATERIALIZED (

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $7 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $7 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $7 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $7 || ' ' || mi.year::text) OR COALESCE(search_alias.exact_title_match, 0) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $8::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $8::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $9 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($9)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi LEFT JOIN alias_scores search_alias ON search_alias.content_id = mi.content_id
		WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (title_mi.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND (mi.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.content_rating_age <= $3) AND (mi.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.advisory_age <= $4) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
UNION ALL

		SELECT DISTINCT 
			ece.episode_id AS content_id,
			'episode'::text AS type,
			ece.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_normalized = $7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,

			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $9 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($9)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) AND si.type = 'series' AND (ece.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.content_rating_age <= $5) AND (ece.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.advisory_age <= $6)
)

WITH search_parameters AS (SELECT $1::text, $2::text, $7::text, $8::int, $9::text),
alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
			SELECT DISTINCT mia.content_id FROM media_item_aliases mia
			WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))),
title_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT mi.content_id FROM media_items mi WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (title_mi.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND (mi.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.content_rating_age <= $3) AND (mi.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.advisory_age <= $4) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id) UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT ece.episode_id AS content_id FROM episode_catalog_entries ece JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) AND si.type = 'series' AND (ece.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.content_rating_age <= $5) AND (ece.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.advisory_age <= $6)),
candidates AS (
		SELECT content_id FROM title_candidates
		UNION ALL
		SELECT content_id FROM (SELECT mi.content_id FROM media_items mi WHERE (mi.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND (mi.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.content_rating_age <= $3) AND (mi.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.advisory_age <= $4) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id) AND ts_rank_cd(mi.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)) >= 0.15 UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT ece.episode_id AS content_id FROM episode_catalog_entries ece JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id WHERE (ece.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND si.type = 'series' AND (ece.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.content_rating_age <= $5) AND (ece.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.advisory_age <= $6) AND ts_rank_cd(ece.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)) >= 0.15) overview_candidates
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM title_candidates)
	) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM candidates

WITH scored AS (
WITH alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
		SELECT
			mia.content_id,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title = $7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE $7 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contiguous_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	),
title_scored AS MATERIALIZED (

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $7 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $7 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $7 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $7 || ' ' || mi.year::text) OR COALESCE(search_alias.exact_title_match, 0) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $8::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $8::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $9 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($9)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi LEFT JOIN alias_scores search_alias ON search_alias.content_id = mi.content_id
		WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (title_mi.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND (mi.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.content_rating_age <= $3) AND (mi.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.advisory_age <= $4) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
UNION ALL

		SELECT DISTINCT 
			ece.episode_id AS content_id,
			'episode'::text AS type,
			ece.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_normalized = $7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,

			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $9 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($9)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) AND si.type = 'series' AND (ece.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.content_rating_age <= $5) AND (ece.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.advisory_age <= $6)
)

WITH search_parameters AS (SELECT $1::text, $2::text, $7::text, $8::int, $9::text),
alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
			SELECT DISTINCT mia.content_id FROM media_item_aliases mia
			WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))),
title_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT mi.content_id FROM media_items mi WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (title_mi.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND (mi.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.content_rating_age <= $3) AND (mi.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.advisory_age <= $4) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id) UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT ece.episode_id AS content_id FROM episode_catalog_entries ece JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) AND si.type = 'series' AND (ece.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.content_rating_age <= $5) AND (ece.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.advisory_age <= $6)),
candidates AS (
		SELECT content_id FROM title_candidates
		UNION ALL
		SELECT content_id FROM (SELECT mi.content_id FROM media_items mi WHERE (mi.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND (mi.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.content_rating_age <= $3) AND (mi.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.advisory_age <= $4) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id) AND ts_rank_cd(mi.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)) >= 0.15 UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT ece.episode_id AS content_id FROM episode_catalog_entries ece JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id WHERE (ece.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND si.type = 'series' AND (ece.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.content_rating_age <= $5) AND (ece.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.advisory_age <= $6) AND ts_rank_cd(ece.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)) >= 0.15) overview_candidates
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM title_candidates)
	) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM candidates

WITH scored AS (
WITH alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
		SELECT
			mia.content_id,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title = $7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE $7 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contiguous_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	),
title_scored AS MATERIALIZED (

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $7 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $7 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $7 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $7 || ' ' || mi.year::text) OR COALESCE(search_alias.exact_title_match, 0) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $8::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $8::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $9 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($9)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi LEFT JOIN alias_scores search_alias ON search_alias.content_id = mi.content_id
		WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (title_mi.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND (mi.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.content_rating_age <= $3) AND (mi.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.advisory_age <= $4) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
UNION ALL

		SELECT DISTINCT 
			ece.episode_id AS content_id,
			'episode'::text AS type,
			ece.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_normalized = $7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE $7 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $7 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,

			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $9 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($9)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) AND si.type = 'series' AND (ece.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.content_rating_age <= $5) AND (ece.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.advisory_age <= $6)
)

			CASE WHEN $9::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $9::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,

WITH alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
		SELECT
			mia.content_id,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title = $8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE $8 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contiguous_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	),
title_scored AS MATERIALIZED (

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $8 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $8 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $8 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $8 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $8 || ' ' || mi.year::text) OR COALESCE(search_alias.exact_title_match, 0) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $8 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $8 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $8 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $9::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $9::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $10 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($10)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi LEFT JOIN alias_scores search_alias ON search_alias.content_id = mi.content_id
		WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (title_mi.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND mi.type = ANY($3) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND (mi.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.content_rating_age <= $4) AND (mi.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.advisory_age <= $5) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
UNION ALL

		SELECT DISTINCT 
			ece.episode_id AS content_id,
			'episode'::text AS type,
			ece.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $8 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_normalized = $8) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE $8 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $9::int IS NOT NULL AND (ece.year) = $9::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(ece.search_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $10 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($10)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) AND si.type = 'series' AND (ece.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.content_rating_age <= $6) AND (ece.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.advisory_age <= $7)
)
SELECT * FROM title_scored
		UNION ALL
		SELECT *
		FROM (
			
		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $8 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $8 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $8 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $8 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $8 || ' ' || mi.year::text)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $8 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $8 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $8 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $9::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $9::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)))::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $10 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($10)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi
		WHERE (mi.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND mi.type = ANY($3) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND (mi.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.content_rating_age <= $4) AND (mi.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND mi.advisory_age <= $5) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
UNION ALL

		SELECT DISTINCT 
			ece.episode_id AS content_id,
			'episode'::text AS type,
			ece.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $8 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_normalized = $8) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE $8 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $9::int IS NOT NULL AND (ece.year) = $9::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $8 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $8 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(ece.search_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(ts_rank_cd(ece.search_overview_vector, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1)))::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $10 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($10)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id
		WHERE (ece.search_overview_vector) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AND si.type = 'series' AND (ece.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.content_rating_age <= $6) AND (ece.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.advisory_age <= $7)
		) overview_scored
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM title_scored)
		  AND overview_scored.overview_rank >= 0.15
), page AS (
		SELECT scored.*, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_count
		FROM scored
		ORDER BY exact_title_match DESC, contiguous_title_match DESC, year_match DESC,
	phrase_rank DESC, title_prefix_rank DESC, overview_rank DESC,
	LOWER(title) ASC, content_id ASC
		LIMIT $11 OFFSET $12
	)
		SELECT hydrated.content_id, hydrated.type, hydrated.title, hydrated.sort_title, hydrated.default_metadata_language, hydrated.original_title, hydrated.year, hydrated.genres, hydrated.content_rating, hydrated.runtime, hydrated.overview, hydrated.tagline, hydrated.rating_imdb, hydrated.rating_tmdb, hydrated.rating_rt_critic, hydrated.rating_rt_audience, hydrated.imdb_id, hydrated.tmdb_id, hydrated.tvdb_id, COALESCE(hydrated.poster_path, '') AS poster_path, COALESCE(hydrated.poster_source_path, '') AS poster_source_path, COALESCE(hydrated.poster_thumbhash, '') AS poster_thumbhash, COALESCE(hydrated.backdrop_path, '') AS backdrop_path, COALESCE(hydrated.backdrop_source_path, '') AS backdrop_source_path, COALESCE(hydrated.backdrop_thumbhash, '') AS backdrop_thumbhash, COALESCE(hydrated.logo_path, '') AS logo_path, COALESCE(hydrated.logo_source_path, '') AS logo_source_path, hydrated.banner_path, hydrated.banner_source_path, hydrated.banner_thumbhash, hydrated.thumb_path, hydrated.thumb_source_path, hydrated.thumb_thumbhash, hydrated.clearart_path, hydrated.clearart_source_path, hydrated.disc_path, hydrated.disc_source_path, COALESCE(hydrated.metadata_s3_path, '') AS metadata_s3_path, COALESCE(hydrated.metadata_etag, '') AS metadata_etag, hydrated.season_count, hydrated.studios, hydrated.networks, hydrated.countries, hydrated.keywords, hydrated.original_language, hydrated.release_date::text, hydrated.first_air_date, hydrated.last_air_date, hydrated.air_time, hydrated.air_timezone, hydrated.show_status, hydrated.matched_at, hydrated.last_refreshed, hydrated.refresh_failures, hydrated.episode_metadata_incomplete, hydrated.episode_metadata_last_checked_at, hydrated.locked_fields, hydrated.status, hydrated.created_at, hydrated.updated_at, hydrated.advisory_age, COALESCE(hydrated.advisory_source, '') AS advisory_source, page.total_count

hydrated_mi.status, hydrated_mi.created_at, hydrated_mi.updated_at, hydrated_mi.advisory_age, COALESCE(hydrated_mi.advisory_source, '') AS advisory_source
		FROM media_items hydrated_mi

		SELECT mi.content_id, mi.type, mi.title, mi.sort_title, mi.default_metadata_language, mi.original_title, mi.year, mi.genres, mi.content_rating, mi.runtime, mi.overview, mi.tagline, mi.rating_imdb, mi.rating_tmdb, mi.rating_rt_critic, mi.rating_rt_audience, mi.imdb_id, mi.tmdb_id, mi.tvdb_id, COALESCE(mi.poster_path, '') AS poster_path, COALESCE(mi.poster_source_path, '') AS poster_source_path, COALESCE(mi.poster_thumbhash, '') AS poster_thumbhash, COALESCE(mi.backdrop_path, '') AS backdrop_path, COALESCE(mi.backdrop_source_path, '') AS backdrop_source_path, COALESCE(mi.backdrop_thumbhash, '') AS backdrop_thumbhash, COALESCE(mi.logo_path, '') AS logo_path, COALESCE(mi.logo_source_path, '') AS logo_source_path, mi.banner_path, mi.banner_source_path, mi.banner_thumbhash, mi.thumb_path, mi.thumb_source_path, mi.thumb_thumbhash, mi.clearart_path, mi.clearart_source_path, mi.disc_path, mi.disc_source_path, COALESCE(mi.metadata_s3_path, '') AS metadata_s3_path, COALESCE(mi.metadata_etag, '') AS metadata_etag, mi.season_count, mi.studios, mi.networks, mi.countries, mi.keywords, mi.original_language, mi.release_date::text, mi.first_air_date, mi.last_air_date, mi.air_time, mi.air_timezone, mi.show_status, mi.matched_at, mi.last_refreshed, mi.refresh_failures, mi.episode_metadata_incomplete, mi.episode_metadata_last_checked_at, mi.locked_fields, mi.status, mi.created_at, mi.updated_at, mi.advisory_age, COALESCE(mi.advisory_source, '') AS advisory_source

		''::text AS clearart_source_path,
		''::text AS disc_path,
		''::text AS disc_source_path,
		COALESCE(e.metadata_s3_path, '') AS metadata_s3_path,
		COALESCE(e.metadata_etag, '') AS metadata_etag,
		NULL::integer AS season_count,

		COALESCE(si.networks, '{}'::text[]) AS networks,

		e.created_at,

	FROM episodes e
	JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = e.series_id
	LEFT JOIN seasons s ON s.content_id = e.season_id
	WHERE (EXISTS (
		SELECT 1
		FROM episode_libraries el

WITH alias_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
			SELECT
				mia.content_id,
				MAX(
					0.65 * similarity($2, mia.normalized_title)
						+ 0.35 * strict_word_similarity($2, mia.normalized_title)
				) AS fuzzy_rank,
				MAX(similarity(public.normalize_search_text($1), mia.normalized_title)) AS fuzzy_full_rank
			FROM media_item_aliases mia
			WHERE $2 <<% mia.normalized_title
			GROUP BY mia.content_id
		), candidates AS (
			SELECT
				mi.content_id,
				0.65 * similarity($2, mi.title_normalized)
					+ 0.35 * strict_word_similarity($2, mi.title_normalized) AS fuzzy_rank,
				similarity(public.normalize_search_text($1), mi.title_normalized) AS fuzzy_full_rank
			FROM media_items mi
			WHERE $2 <<% mi.title_normalized
			UNION ALL
			SELECT content_id, fuzzy_rank, fuzzy_full_rank
			FROM alias_candidates
		), candidate_scores AS (
			SELECT content_id, MAX(fuzzy_rank) AS fuzzy_rank, MAX(fuzzy_full_rank) AS fuzzy_full_rank
			FROM candidates
			GROUP BY content_id

WITH scored AS (
WITH alias_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
		SELECT
			mia.content_id,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title = $5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE $5 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $5 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contiguous_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $5 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $5 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	),
title_scored AS MATERIALIZED (

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,
			mi.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $5 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $5 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $5 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $5 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $5 || ' ' || mi.year::text) OR COALESCE(search_alias.exact_title_match, 0) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $5 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $5 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $5 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $5 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $5 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $5 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $5 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $6::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $6::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $5 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $5 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $5 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $5 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($7)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM media_items mi LEFT JOIN alias_scores search_alias ON search_alias.content_id = mi.content_id
		WHERE mi.content_id IN (SELECT title_mi.content_id FROM media_items title_mi WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (title_mi.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) UNION SELECT alias_scores.content_id FROM alias_scores) AND COALESCE((SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries in_library WHERE in_library.content_id = mi.content_id) OFFSET 0), FALSE) AND NOT (mi.type = ANY($3)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM manga_chapters mc WHERE mc.chapter_content_id = mi.content_id)
UNION ALL

		SELECT DISTINCT 
			ece.episode_id AS content_id,
			'episode'::text AS type,
			ece.title AS title,
			CASE WHEN $5 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_normalized = $5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $5 <> '' THEN CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE $5 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $5 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $6::int IS NOT NULL AND (ece.year) = $6::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + CASE WHEN $5 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN ece.search_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $5 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(ece.search_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END))::float8, ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2)) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,
			(CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(ece.search_title_vector, phraseto_tsquery('simple', public.normalize_search_text($7)), 2) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS phrase_rank
		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece JOIN media_items si ON si.content_id = ece.series_id
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (ece.search_title_vector) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2))) AND si.type = 'series' AND NOT ('episode' = ANY($4))
)

			CASE WHEN $6::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $6::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $5 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $5 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $5 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $5 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,

			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $5 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $5 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	),
title_scored AS MATERIALIZED (

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,

			CASE WHEN $5 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $5 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $5 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $5 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $5 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $5 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $5 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $6::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $6::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $5 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $5 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $5 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $5 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,

			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE $5 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $5 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contiguous_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,
			MIN(CASE WHEN $5 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $5 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mia.normalized_title, ' '), 1) END) END) AS contiguous_title_words
		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	),
title_scored AS MATERIALIZED (

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,

			CASE WHEN $5 <> '' AND (mi.title_normalized = $5 OR mi.original_title_normalized = $5 OR mi.sort_title_normalized = $5 OR (mi.year > 0 AND mi.title_normalized = $5 || ' ' || mi.year::text) OR COALESCE(search_alias.exact_title_match, 0) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS exact_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $5 <> '' THEN GREATEST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE $5 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE $5 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE $5 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $5 || '%' OR mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $5 || '%' OR mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $5 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(search_alias.contiguous_title_match, 0)) ELSE 0 END AS contiguous_title_match,
			CASE WHEN $6::int IS NOT NULL AND (mi.year) = $6::int THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS year_match,
			(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN COALESCE((1.0 / (1 + LEAST(CASE WHEN $5 <> '' THEN LEAST(CASE WHEN mi.title_normalized LIKE '%' || $5 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.original_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $5 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.original_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END, CASE WHEN mi.sort_title_normalized LIKE '%' || $5 || '%' THEN array_length(string_to_array(mi.sort_title_normalized, ' '), 1) END) END, search_alias.contiguous_title_words)))::float8, GREATEST(ts_rank_cd(mi.search_title_vector, to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2), COALESCE(search_alias.title_prefix_rank, 0))) ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS title_prefix_rank,
			(0::real)::float8 AS overview_rank,

		SELECT
			mia.content_id,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title = $6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE $6 || '%' THEN 2 WHEN mia.normalized_title LIKE '%' || $6 || '%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contiguous_title_match,
			MAX(CASE WHEN $2 <> '' THEN ts_rank_cd(setweight(to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title), 'A'), to_tsquery('simple', $2), 2) ELSE 0 END) AS title_prefix_rank,

		FROM media_item_aliases mia
		WHERE (($2 <> '' AND (to_tsvector('simple', mia.normalized_title)) @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)))
		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	),

		SELECT 
			mi.content_id AS content_id,
			mi.type AS type,

		GROUP BY mia.content_id
	),
title_scored AS MATERIALIZED (

		SELECT
